reviews.comment: He missed lots of class but would expect us to advance our projects without feedback from him lol. His lectures were mostly just copy and paste things from AIA & no new material. He might just have too much on his plate lowkey

If you have a choice of professor, do not take Hawkins. He has a few class favorites that he will joke with and caress their backs; but if you're not them, you're done for. Has very little to say about student ideas, and doesn't care much for creative liberty. If you end up with him, you might reach out to other professors for critic and feedback.

If you value your time and education, avoid taking this professor. He frequently misses class or shows up extremely late. Despite emphasizing the importance of education, he fails to practice what he preaches and doesn't teach much during the limited time he's present. Save yourself the frustration and choose a professor who respects students time.

He's a good professor, but just misses a lot of classes, either that or he's late a lot. There are times you can tell he doesn't feel like teaching. He gives good feedback though and responds to emails in a timely manner.

Good ol Hawkins! He was my first architecture studio instructor and I'm so glad I got him. He was very forgiving with minor deadlines as long as he knew you'd get the work done soon and was so chill about everything. Studio is a lot of work and time, so don't fool yourself into thinking it will be an easy A if you don't put the work though
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Though I had a hard time in this studio, I thoroughly enjoyed it. He knows how to challenge you for sure, but in a good way. He is super chill and approachable. I appreciate his feedback on projects and he guides you without telling you exactly what to do. I recommend him and can't wait to be in his studio next semester.

Strong dad vibes. The class was difficut, integrated studio and all. He will come in and say he hates you and everyone will get an F, but im sure its a joke... right? He will push you and encourage you in his own way. We have had many fun conversations as a class. He will be real with you. Great guy.
